notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Jirina.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Human Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Human Soldier.
